rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own home (basement structure, flooring, and contents) caused by failure of the policyholder's own internal plumbing system.
claim_summary: Homeowner returned from work trip to find basement flooded with approximately 2 inches of water due to burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink that ran for roughly two days. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, water-soaked drywall to 1 foot height, and ruined stored contents. Estimated loss likely exceeds $25,000; high-severity property damage claim requiring urgent on-site assessment.

case_facts.description: 2 inches of water across entire basement; hardwood floor buckled; drywall soaked up to 1 foot; stored boxes ruined
case_facts.cause: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink; ran for approximately two days while policyholder was away

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles) with no third-party injury or involvement.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch overhang; four shingles blown off last weekend with no water intrusion. Estimated repair cost $400. Policyholder deductible is $2,500, so claim is currently below deductible threshold but being routed for documentation and adjuster review of actual repair costs.

case_facts.description: wind damage, four shingles blown off
